env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

env CC=

# No logos.toml: the default cgo policy forbids cgo, and ./... must
# reject the cgo-only package instead of silently dropping it.
# The denial happens at load, so these cases run without a C compiler.
! logos build ./...
stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\]'
! logos lint ./...
stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\]'

# An explicit forbid in logos.toml is the same policy.
cd forbid
! logos build ./...
stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\]'
! logos lint ./...
stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\]'
cd ..

# A package whose cgo file is excluded by an unset build tag is not
# part of this build: ./... must keep skipping it in silence.
cd tagged
logos build ./...
! stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\]'
logos lint ./...
! stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\]'

# An explicit path reaches logosCgoHidden. A `cgo && spira_custom` file
# with spira_custom unset must report the unmet constraints, not a cgo
# denial: enabling cgo alone would not admit the file.
! logos build ./c2
stderr 'build constraints exclude'
! stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\]'
# With the tag set the only thing hiding the package is cgo.
! logos build -tags=spira_custom ./c2
stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\]'

# A `package documentation` file is never admitted by ImportDir, so an
# explicit path reports the missing sources rather than a cgo denial.
! logos build ./docs
stderr 'build constraints exclude'
! stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\]'
cd ..

# A restricted policy with an empty allowlist denies every cgo package.
# These blocks compile C, so they only run where cgo works.
[cgo] cd restricted
[cgo] ! logos build ./...
[cgo] stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\]'
[cgo] ! logos lint ./...
[cgo] stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\]'
[cgo] cd ..

# Control: an allowlisted package still builds under ./...
# with the restricted policy.
[cgo] cd restricted
[cgo] logos build ./allowed
[cgo] cd ..

-- go.mod --
module example.com/f06

go 1.27

-- main.lgo --
package main

func main() {}

-- c/c.lgo --
package c

// int one(void) { return 1; }
import "C"

func One() int { return int(C.one()) }

-- forbid/go.mod --
module example.com/f06forbid

go 1.27

-- forbid/logos.toml --
[build]
cgo = "forbid"

-- forbid/main.lgo --
package main

func main() {}

-- forbid/c/c.lgo --
package c

// int one(void) { return 1; }
import "C"

func One() int { return int(C.one()) }

-- tagged/go.mod --
module example.com/f06tagged

go 1.27

-- tagged/logos.toml --
[build]
cgo = "forbid"

-- tagged/main.lgo --
package main

func main() {}

-- tagged/c/c.lgo --
//go:build spira_never_set

package c

// int one(void) { return 1; }
import "C"

func One() int { return int(C.one()) }

-- tagged/c2/c2.lgo --
//go:build cgo && spira_custom

package c2

// int two(void) { return 2; }
import "C"

func Two() int { return int(C.two()) }

-- tagged/docs/d.lgo --
package documentation

// int three(void) { return 3; }
import "C"

-- restricted/go.mod --
module example.com/f06restricted

go 1.27

-- restricted/logos.toml --
[build]
cgo = "restricted"
cgo_allowlist = ["example.com/f06restricted/allowed/**"]

-- restricted/main.lgo --
package main

func main() {}

-- restricted/c/c.lgo --
package c

// int one(void) { return 1; }
import "C"

func One() int { return int(C.one()) }

-- restricted/allowed/allowed.lgo --
package allowed

/*
int one(void) { return 1; }
*/
import "C"

func One() int { return int(C.one()) }
